title: Gradient Descent Step
prompt:
Gradient descent on f(x) = x^2 (so ∇f = 2x).

From x_k = -4 with step size α = 1/10, compute the next iterate x_k − α·∇f(x_k).
hint: x_k − α·2·x_k; an exact fraction or a decimal is accepted
recap: Gradient descent updates x ← x − α·∇f(x). For f = x^2, ∇f = 2x, so one step gives (1 − 2α)x. The step size α sets how far you descend.
